sources.name: Kuwait Government Online history and institutions
sources.rights_note: Store citations, hashes, and permitted extracts; preserve government-site terms.
sources.automation_note: Narrative overview; corroborate exact dates with primary records.

sources.name: Kuwait Alyawm Official Gazette
sources.rights_note: Ministry retains publication rights; archive metadata and hashes unless reuse terms permit more.
sources.automation_note: Prefer issue/PDF identifiers; never treat search snippets as the gazette text.

sources.name: Commercial Registry electronic services
sources.organization: Kuwait Ministry of Commerce and Industry
sources.rights_note: Do not publish personal or access-controlled registry data; retain approved identifiers and receipts only.
sources.automation_note: Human/login steps may be required; do not bypass authentication or CAPTCHA.

sources.name: Capital Markets Authority records
sources.rights_note: Preserve official-document precedence and correction chains.
sources.automation_note: Regulatory notices prove only their stated procedural action and date.

sources.name: Boursa Kuwait company disclosures and exchange history
sources.rights_note: Respect exchange terms and document rights; no claim of complete history from index reachability.
sources.automation_note: Listed-company universe only; join by effective-dated official security/company identifiers.

sources.name: Economic, annual, and financial stability reports
sources.rights_note: Record report edition, table, unit, revision, and publication date.
sources.automation_note: Annual and periodic series; do not infer company-specific facts from aggregates.

sources.name: Annual statistical abstracts and establishment surveys
sources.rights_note: Preserve source tables, units, reference periods, and revision labels.
sources.automation_note: Aggregate establishment counts do not enumerate legal companies.

sources.name: Justice services, court notices, and judgment-copy routes
sources.rights_note: Court access and personal-data restrictions control; never bulk-publish protected case data.
sources.automation_note: A news notice is not a judgment; capture docket, court, stage, and finality separately.

sources.name: Anti-corruption referrals and publications
sources.rights_note: Preserve procedural wording and privacy; a referral is not a conviction.
sources.automation_note: Encode ALLEGED/REFERRED/CHARGED/DECIDED/APPEALED/FINAL explicitly.

sources.name: Direct-investment annual reports
sources.rights_note: Retain annual-report edition and reporting-period metadata.
sources.automation_note: Covers direct-investment authority scope, not the full company universe.

sources.name: Kuwait Oil Company official history
sources.rights_note: Cite official milestones; archive page version and capture time.
sources.automation_note: Issuer-authored history requires independent corroboration for disputed claims.

sources.name: Kuwait Investment Authority history and funds
sources.rights_note: Do not infer undisclosed holdings; cite only public statements and reports.
sources.automation_note: Official institutional history, not a complete portfolio record.

sources.name: National Library digital collections
sources.rights_note: Collection and item rights vary; store catalog metadata unless item reuse is licensed.
sources.automation_note: Some holdings require manual or physical access; preserve catalog gaps.

sources.name: Digitized British Library Gulf and Kuwait records
sources.organization: Qatar Digital Library and British Library
sources.rights_note: Follow item-level reuse and attribution statements; retain shelfmarks and folio references.
sources.automation_note: Colonial records are primary for their authors, not neutral truth; triangulate local history.

sources.name: Kuwait country reports and historical economic studies
sources.rights_note: Respect publication-specific license/paywall; store citations and permitted extracts.
sources.automation_note: Useful for Souk Al-Manakh, invasion, crises, and macro context; distinguish analysis from official Kuwait records.

sources.name: Kuwait and GCC economic updates
sources.rights_note: Preserve indicator version, license, and retrieval date.
sources.automation_note: Macro corroboration only; not a company registry or case source.

sources.name: Kuwait News Agency
sources.rights_note: Do not republish full articles; retain citations, hashes, and short permitted extracts.
sources.automation_note: Agency reporting is secondary unless reproducing an identifiable official statement.

sources.name: Kuwait Times and historical archive
sources.rights_note: Copyrighted press; store metadata, citations, hashes, and permitted snippets only.
sources.automation_note: Verify archive coverage per year; absence from search is not absence of an event.

sources.name: Al Qabas newspaper archive
sources.rights_note: Copyrighted press; do not bulk-republish articles.
sources.automation_note: Use entity aliases and date windows; corroborate company/legal facts with primary sources.

sources.name: Al Rai newspaper
sources.rights_note: Copyrighted press; retain citations and permitted extracts only.
sources.automation_note: Secondary corroboration; preserve corrections and publication times.

sources.name: Al Anba newspaper
sources.rights_note: Copyrighted press; retain citations and permitted extracts only.
sources.automation_note: Secondary corroboration; require primary evidence for founders, status, and cases.

sources.name: Al Jarida newspaper
sources.rights_note: Copyrighted press; retain citations and permitted extracts only.
sources.automation_note: Secondary corroboration; capture canonical URL and correction chain.

sources.name: Internet Archive web captures
sources.rights_note: Archive access does not grant rights to underlying content.
sources.automation_note: Use only as time-bound archive context; preserve original publisher identity.

sources.name: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and public social posts
sources.rights_note: Honor platform terms, privacy, deletion, and access controls; do not archive private content.
sources.automation_note: Routing/sentiment only and only after each platform existed; never proves legal or company facts.

sources.name: Public Kuwait community forums
sources.rights_note: Do not collect private profiles or bypass login; minimize personal data.
sources.automation_note: Rumor lead and sentiment only; independent primary verification is mandatory.

sources.name: Wikipedia routing index
sources.rights_note: Follow CC BY-SA and revision attribution when reused.
sources.automation_note: Use references and aliases for routing only; never final evidence.
